jobs.description:
**Description**
Are you eager to shape the future of video entertainment, from movies and TV shows to live sports events? Do you enjoy tackling complex challenges within large-scale systems? If so, we invite you to help build the future of entertainment with us at Prime Video!
  
  
Since its launch in 2007, Prime Video has been transforming the traditional television and movie industry. With a rapidly expanding library of high-quality content and availability in over 240 countries and territories, Prime Video is now a key strategic priority for Amazon. We invest heavily in acquiring, producing, and programming a diverse range of TV shows, movies, and live events. Our exclusive titles include "The Lord of the Rings," "The Boys," "The Wheel of Time," and "The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel," among others. Beyond our extensive On-Demand catalog, Prime Video offers a wide selection of Linear Channels and Live Sports, featuring major events like Thursday Night Football, the English Premier League, NBA, MLB, ATP tennis, French Open, and the UEFA Champions League. If this sparks your interest, read on!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable systems that power Prime Video’s streaming services.
* Define the architecture for our software, utilizing a broad range of technologies, programming languages, and systems.
* Implement and operate APIs that manage billions of playback start requests, ensuring seamless, low-latency content delivery.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to influence the overall technical strategy and contribute to the team’s long-term roadmap.
* Communicate effectively across teams and stakeholders, ensuring alignment with technical goals and project timelines.
* Apply creative problem-solving skills to address complex challenges.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and new technologies, integrating them where appropriate. Fluency in GenAI based developer efficiency tools is a plus.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, contributing to the overall growth and success of the engineering team.

A day in the life
  
  
As a software engineer on the Prime Video team, my day starts with diving into hands-on coding and technical problem-solving. I’m not just writing code—I’m helping to shape the architecture of complex systems that millions of people rely on every day. One of the most rewarding aspects of my role is seeing my work come to life when friends and family use Prime Video to watch their favorite shows and live sports.
  
  
My primary focus is on designing and maintaining the APIs that power every title on Prime Video. This involves creating highly reliable and low-latency systems that ensure users can start streaming their content with just a click. The challenges are unique, especially when it comes to managing the sheer scale of requests we handle daily. To tackle these, I leverage AWS technologies like EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis, and CloudFront.
  
  
Collaboration is a significant aspect of my role. I collaborate with a cross-functional team to align our technical strategies and define our long-term roadmap. It’s exhilarating to influence decisions that will shape the future of Prime Video. Throughout the day, I alternate between deep focus on coding and brainstorming sessions with my teammates to tackle novel challenges.
  
  
Beyond the technical work, I also play a key role in mentoring junior engineers. Sharing my knowledge and seeing others grow is incredibly fulfilling. I’m always encouraged to push the boundaries of what’s possible, and I have the freedom to explore new ideas that can elevate our service to the next level.
  
  
At the end of the day, I know that the work I do directly contributes to a world-class viewing experience for millions of Prime Video users, and that’s a great feeling.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

jobs.description:
**Description**
What if you could talk to your Amazon Store? With Alexa+ on Echo Show, customers can now do exactly that. The full Amazon store is live on Echo Show 15 and 21 — a new way to shop at home that combines voice as a natural way to express needs with the product details, reviews, and videos customers rely on to make confident decisions.
  
  
This product started with an ambitious question and was built from scratch — no prior version to iterate on, no existing architecture to extend, no playbook to follow. The team pioneered novel challenges including rendering the full, always-current Amazon store natively on Echo Show in real time, building visual grounding from scratch so Alexa's responses stay anchored to what the customer sees on screen, and creating a conversational commerce paradigm that lets customers skip screens entirely with natural language.
  
  
We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to help build the next chapter of this experience — scaling what we've built, expanding to new surfaces and marketplaces, and pushing the boundaries of agentic, multimodal shopping. As an early-career engineer on this team, you'll design and build meaningful components alongside experienced engineers, own your work through design, implementation, testing, and livesite, and grow quickly in a high-ownership environment.
  
  
This is greenfield, 0→1 work at the intersection of Generative AI, multimodal experiences, and conversational commerce. You will have the freedom to experiment, learn, and invent on behalf of our customers, and you'll work for a strong leadership team that optimizes for your growth and pairs you with mentors who will guide your career.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer I on this team, you will:
  
  

* Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
* Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
* Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
* Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
* Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
* Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
* Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

A day in the life
  
  
Here's what a typical day might look like. You'll spend meaningful time building — designing and implementing features that scale the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices, whether that's improving how the store renders in real time, sharpening visual grounding, or extending the experience to a new marketplace. You'll write code, review your teammates', and get thoughtful feedback on yours.
  
  
Days blend focused coding with a short standup, design conversations where your ideas are genuinely wanted, and pairing with a senior engineer or mentor when you're working through something ambiguous. Because this is 0→1 work, you'll often be making decisions without a playbook — and that's the fun part. You'll partner closely with engineering, science, product, and design colleagues across Alexa Shopping, many of them in Seattle, so some collaboration spans time zones.
  
  
Your internal stakeholders are the product, design, and partner engineering teams shaping the Alexa+ shopping experience; your end customers are shoppers at home talking to their Echo Show, expecting it to just work. The problems you'll tackle range from "how do we keep the store always in sync and fast on-device?" to "how do we make a conversational shopping flow feel effortless?" — meaty, customer-facing problems where what you build lands in people's living rooms.
  
  
**About The Team**
We're the team that taught the Amazon Store to talk back. We took an idea that didn't have a blueprint and shipped it to customers' living rooms — and now we're just getting to the fun part: making it bigger, faster, and available to shoppers around the world.
  
  
Our mission is simple to say and hard to do: make shopping on Alexa feel effortless and delightful, no matter where a customer is or which device they reach for. We sit right where voice, vision, and Generative AI meet retail at Amazon scale — which means the problems we solve genuinely haven't been solved before, and the person who cracks them is often the newest engineer with a fresh idea.
  
  
Culture-wise, we're builders who like ambiguity and dislike bureaucracy. We ship, we learn, we tell stories over chai, and we celebrate the wins (and the instructive failures). We hire smart people and give them room to run — you'll own real problems from day one, with experienced engineers and mentors in your corner, not looking over your shoulder. We take the work seriously and ourselves a little less so. If you like the idea of building something customers can literally talk to, you'll fit right in.

* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
Analytics is undergoing a fundamental shift, from traditional data science toward AI-driven analytics product development. As business intelligence evolves into intelligent, AI-powered tooling, we are looking for someone eager to help lead this transformation.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of analytics, product, and AI. You will play a key part in reimagining our Business Intelligence ecosystem as a suite of AI-native applications, stepping into the role of an AI Analytics Product Manager.
  
  
We are building toward a future where business and product teams can diagnose performance, uncover insights, and take action through AI-enabled experiences. If you’re motivated to move beyond analysis into productizing intelligence and want to shape how eBay interacts with data in the AI era, this is an opportunity to be at the forefront of that journey.

Help us build the next generation of AI-first analytics — tools that let anyone explore data insights, visualize results instantly, and understand the “why” behind the numbers. You’ll work across the stack, from React dashboards to analytical APIs, with a focus on insight delivery, data storytelling, and evidence-based decision-making. You’ll bridge UX, data, and AI so that human questions become data-grounded answers in seconds.

* Integrate AI-assisted analysis: connect front-end workflows to agentic pipelines that query, aggregate, and explain.

* Analytical APIs (e.g. FastAPI), data validation, and async retrieval.
* SQL / data modeling for metrics computation, and time series analysis.
* LLM/agent analytics (prompt design, RAG, evaluation, grounding).
* Data storytelling & visualization fundamentals — clear charts, tables, and contextual narratives.
* Experience measuring insight quality via evals, A/B tests, or golden datasets.
* Excellent communication — explain analytical logic, trade-offs, and findings clearly.
* 6-10 yrs of relevant Work Exp.

Nice to have
  
  

* Familiarity with databases, semantic layers, or retrieval systems.
* Background in UX for data visualization or analytical workflows.
* Familiarity with experiment frameworks, metrics stores, or statistical testing.
* Experience in software deployment (e.g. Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with DevOps workflows, including automated testing pipelines, secret management, and maintaining high-availability cloud environments

Analysts and stakeholders can ask complex questions in plain English, see grounded, visualized answers within seconds, and trust the insights enough to act on them. The product reduces time-to-decision, increases data confidence, and becomes a daily habit for decision-makers.

jobs.title: Embedded System Engineer
jobs.description:
**About ULOOK**

ULOOK is a deep-tech company pioneering an Indigenous Autonomous RF-Intelligence Stack from orbit. We develop autonomous satellite swarms and advance RF sensing technologies which transform faint electromagnetic emissions into real-time intelligence. With our proprietary technology we identify, geolocate and fingerprint complex signals in environments where traditional sensors fail. We operate at the intersection of defense, space, and intelligence, providing global partners with unmatched situational awareness across all domains.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an Embedded Systems Engineer with 3–6 years of experience to support firmware development, board bring-up, and system-level integration of space-grade embedded platforms. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with C/C++, Python, Linux-based environments, and diverse evaluation boards. Your contributions will be vital to realizing autonomous in-orbit signal detection and processing capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop embedded firmware in C/C++ for FPGAs (RF-SoC)
* Bring up evaluation boards and custom hardware platforms with peripheral interfaces like SPI, I2C, UART, and PCIe
* Develop and configure custom Linux device trees, bootloaders, and kernel modules
* Design and write custom device drivers
* Implement Python-based scripts for hardware automation, testing, and data logging
* Collaborate with hardware and RF teams for system integration, sensor interfacing, and performance validation
* Support unit testing, hardware-in-loop simulations, and driver development for mission-critical applications
* Maintain documentation, version control, and compliance with design processes suitable for space systems

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or related technical fields
* 3+ years of experience in kernel-level embedded Linux development and custom board bring-up
* Proven ability to write custom Linux device drivers from scratch (not just user-space scripting)
* Proficiency in C/C++; good Python scripting skills
* Experience working with Linux device trees, kernel configuration, and bootloader customization
* Strong understanding of hardware-software interfacing, including handling hardware interrupts and DMA for high-throughput sensor data
* Demonstrated ability to work with datasheets, schematics, and board support packages (BSPs)
* Familiarity with debugging tools like JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and serial consoles

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Direct experience working with Xilinx RFSoC or similar FPGA-based architectures.
* Prior experience integrating custom Software Defined Radios (SDRs) or high-speed RF frontends.
* Exposure to embedded systems for aerospace, or defense-grade applications.
* Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking systems.
* Comfortable with cross-functional collaboration involving RF, signal processing, and systems teams.

**Why Join ULOOK**

* Collaborate with a globally experienced core team from aerospace and defense domains.
* Opportunity to build next-generation embedded systems for real-time space intelligence.

If you are excited to challenge yourself, send “Application for Embedded Systems Engineer” as the subject line.

jobs.description:
**Robotics Engineer AI, Robotics & Automation**

**Company:** inGen Dynamics  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 0 - 10 Years

**Locations & Roles**

**Onsite**

**Robotics Development, Integration & Testing**

**Robotics Software, Simulation & Documentation**

**About inGen Dynamics**

inGen Dynamics is a deep-tech company specializing in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Automation, Autonomous Systems, and Industry 4.0 technologies. We design and build intelligent robotic platforms and collaborate with academic institutions and industry partners to deliver innovative, technology-driven solutions.

We are seeking motivated, hands-on engineers who are passionate about building robots, solving real-world engineering problems, and growing their careers in robotics and autonomous systems.

**Role Overview**

As a Robotics Engineer, you will design, build, program, integrate, and test robotic systems. Depending on the selected location and role, you will contribute to hardware prototyping, embedded and robot software development, sensor integration, simulation, testing, and technical documentation for robotics and automation projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Robotics Development, Integration & Testing**

* Assist in the design, assembly, wiring, and prototyping of robotic systems and subsystems.
* Integrate and calibrate sensors, actuators, motors, and controllers on robotic platforms.
* Develop and test robot software and firmware in areas such as:

Robot Operating System (ROS / ROS 2)

Python & C/C++ Programming

Embedded Systems & Microcontrollers (Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi)

Motor Control & Kinematics

Computer Vision & Perception

Navigation, Localization & SLAM

* Conduct functional testing, debugging, and troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, and software issues.
* Support field trials, robot demonstrations, and deployments at customer and partner sites.
* Maintain lab equipment, tools, components, and inventory in the robotics lab.
* Follow safety standards and best practices while working with robotic hardware.
* Record test results, prepare reports, and share findings with the engineering team.

**Robotics Software, Simulation & Documentation**

* Develop, test, and maintain robot software modules using ROS/ROS 2, Python, and C++.
* Build and run robot simulations using tools such as Gazebo, Webots, or Isaac Sim.
* Implement and evaluate algorithms for perception, path planning, navigation, and control.
* Work with version control (Git), code reviews, and continuous integration practices.
* Prepare technical documentation, user manuals, design notes, and test reports.
* Research emerging robotics technologies, open-source tools, and industry trends.

**Educational Qualifications**

**Required**

Bachelor's or Master's Degree (B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech) in:

* Robotics Engineering
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Electrical & Electronics Engineering
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
* Mechanical Engineering
* Related Engineering Disciplines

**Required Skills**

* Python and/or C/C++ Programming
* Fundamentals of ROS / ROS 2
* Basics of Embedded Systems, Microcontrollers, and Electronics
* Understanding of Sensors, Actuators, and Motor Control
* Fundamentals of Robot Kinematics and Control Systems
* Familiarity with Linux and Git
* Problem-Solving, Debugging, and Analytical Thinking
* Good Communication and Teamwork Skills

**Preferred Profile**

* Hands-on experience building robots through academic projects, internships, or competitions.
* Exposure to Computer Vision (OpenCV), AI/ML frameworks, or SLAM and navigation stacks.
* Familiarity with CAD tools (SolidWorks, Fusion 360) or PCB design is an added advantage.
* Participation in robotics competitions, hackathons, or technical clubs.
* Strong curiosity, eagerness to learn, and willingness to work in a fast-paced environment.

**Experience**

* Candidates with 010 years of experience in robotics, automation, embedded systems, or related engineering roles are welcome to apply.
* Fresh graduates with strong technical fundamentals and practical robotics project experience are encouraged to apply.
* Experienced candidates may take on greater ownership of system design, technical leadership, and mentoring of team members.

**Why Join inGen Dynamics?**

* Work on real-world robotics, AI, and autonomous systems projects from day one.
* Collaborate with experienced engineers and mentors in Deep Technology.
* Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge Industry 4.0 and advanced robotics platforms.
* Collaborative, innovation-driven, and growth-focused work culture.
* Continuous learning, professional development, and career advancement opportunities.

**Application Instructions**

Interested candidates should mention their preferred role and location while applying:

* Robotics Development, Integration & Testing
* Robotics Software, Simulation & Documentation

**Apply with your updated resume, links to your project portfolio or GitHub (if available), and a brief note highlighting your robotics experience and preferred role.**
